title: Crystal structures confirm an RFdiffusion3-designed phosphotriesterase, ZAPP-1
summary: Two crystal structures of ZAPP-1, a phosphotriesterase designed de novo with RFdiffusion3, at 1.42 and 2.28 A closely match the design model (C-alpha RMSD 0.69-0.99 A). The higher-resolution structure shows the designed dinuclear Zn(II) site with carbamylated K16. Catalytic residues are near the designed geometry but flexible, and AlphaFold3 predicted the designed conformation with substrate bound. This follows an earlier biochemical paper; the enzyme hydrolyzes organophosphates, and the abstract suggests better active-site preorganization is needed.
ai_technology: RFdiffusion3 de novo enzyme design; AlphaFold3 conformation prediction

evidence.tested: X-ray crystal structures of the designed enzyme, with prior biochemical characterization.
evidence.unknown: Catalytic efficiency in this report; the induced-fit interpretation; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: RFdiffusion3 designed the enzyme whose structure was solved.
